purpose: Quality-gate review for the next pipeline batch after PR 153. No inventory status, R2, or site-content changes were made by this review.
quality_standard: Retain substantive official records that explain policy, analysis, evidence, decisions, or historically important municipal operations. Do not publish thin administrative records as standalone links. Consolidate related sparse historical records while preserving every original, source URL, size, checksum, and verification result.

standalone_pass.title: City of Albuquerque Parking System Review: Parking Operations and Financial Review, October 2002 (Carl Walker, Inc.)
standalone_pass.reason: Substantive City-commissioned operational, governance, supply-and-demand, and financial analysis; not represented elsewhere in the archive. Historical date must be explicit.

standalone_pass.title: Analysis of Albuquerque's Industrial Revenue Bond Program, April 2002 (Prager Company with NatCity Investments and Teresa Cordova)
standalone_pass.reason: Substantive analysis of a major City economic-development financing instrument. Publish beside, not instead of, its companion stakeholder study.

standalone_pass.title: Albuquerque's Industrial Revenue Bond Program: Community Stakeholder Perspectives and Recommendations, May 2002 (Teresa Cordova, Ph.D.)
standalone_pass.reason: Substantive qualitative companion to the Prager analysis, preserving stakeholder evidence and recommendations omitted from the quantitative report.

standalone_pass.title: Police Oversight Project, City of Albuquerque, May 2002 (Richard Jerome, P.C., and the Police Assessment Resource Center)
standalone_pass.reason: Substantive independent historical assessment that establishes the earliest police-oversight baseline in the inventory. Must be labeled historical, not current practice.

standalone_pass.title: APD Total Compensation Comparison and Overtime Cost Management Analysis, March 19, 2001 (Watson Wyatt)
standalone_pass.reason: Substantive fiscal and workforce analysis of police compensation and overtime, absent elsewhere in the archive. Historical date must be prominent.

standalone_pass.title: Structuring A New Urban Government: A Report on the Unification of Bernalillo County and the City of Albuquerque, November 12, 2002 (David Rusk and the Unification Exploratory Group)
standalone_pass.reason: Substantive Council-commissioned study of City-County governmental unification. Description must make clear that the proposal was studied, not enacted.

consolidated_series_pass.working_title: Albuquerque Impact Fee Studies and Committee Record, 2004-2005
consolidated_series_pass.publication_decision: All eight originals pass as source material, but they should not become eight standalone site entries. Preserve and verify each original in R2, then publish one provenance-preserving historical master containing the service-area map, three technical fee studies, consultant methodology summary, and three statutory committee responses.
consolidated_series_pass.quality_reason: Together the records explain the legal and analytical basis, calculation method, geography, historical fee examples, and review-body response. Individually, several eight-to-eleven-page committee records would create sparse link clutter.
consolidated_series_pass.known_gap: The directory does not contain the underlying roadway facilities impact-fee study; the methodology summary and committee comments may be retained, but the compilation must disclose that missing source and must not imply completeness beyond the eight verified originals.
consolidated_series_pass.dating_caution: All figures and recommendations are historical. The visible title and description must identify the 2004-2005 period and must not present the fees as current.

deferred_package_review.reason: Potentially valuable, but the approved set mixes one complete Part 1 volume with Part 2 chapter fragments. Confirm whether an authoritative complete Part 2 exists or build a single provenance-preserving Part 2 master before publication.

The sixteen plan fragments should never be published as sixteen links. Verify the contiguous package and create one provenance-preserving plan master; review the staff report, protest response, and comprehensive plan separately for standalone value and version relationships.

next_action: At the next usage window, verify current official bytes for the six standalone reports and eight impact-fee originals against Claude's recorded sizes and SHA-256 values; resolve exact canonical pages; archive and publicly verify every original; build and verify the single impact-fee master; then update inventory and site content. Do not make any visible addition before exact public R2 verification.
